content: BUD-18 PR 107 defines htree:// immutable nhash/path and mutable npub/tree/path references, visibility modes public/link-private/owner-private, dedicated root kind 30064 with legacy 30078 read compatibility, and nhash bech32 TLV including legacy raw 32-byte decode rule. Pitfalls include event kind collisions, TLV namespace errors, visibility key leakage, and relay/server hint trust boundaries.
